Discover Prepinson

Dalton de Prepinson — From Prepinson to the USA

Bred and raised at Prepinson, Dalton began his training with Helena Bicker and continued with Jan Brink at Tullstorp Dressage Stable in Sweden. He was sold to the United States in 2025.

Juni de Prepinson — A star in the making

Born and raised at Prepinson, Juni became a shared investment with Lisen and Peder Fredricson in 2025. She is in show jumping training at Grevlunda in Sweden.

Jackson de Prepinson — A milestone for Prepinson

Jackson was the first Prepinson-bred horse approved as a stallion by Selle Français and Swedish Warmblood. He was later gelded for his career as a show jumper.
